tolerance.full: within a week of continuous use

toxicities: Common label-reported effects include somnolence, dizziness, dry mouth, constipation, weight gain, and postural hypotension.

Serious label warnings include neuroleptic malignant syndrome, tardive dyskinesia, severe hyperglycemia, agranulocytosis, seizures, and QT prolongation reported after overdose or with additional risk factors.
Somnolence, postural hypotension, and motor or sensory instability can lead to falls, fractures, or other injury; abrupt discontinuation may cause withdrawal symptoms.
